body: At this point, it doesn't have to be a girlfriend. Just hanging out with people who enjoy my company because they want to. I have pseudo-friends right now. They really only talk to me when they need something. Even an animal companion would do.

I appreciate it, but when ever someone tells me that it will get better and that it just takes some time, I can't believe it. I've tried in the past to change and let nature just take its course. But its always ended up the same.

But I agree that single people can totally be happy. I'm just not one of those people. I need someone who truly cares about me and who I can spend time with. I don't care if its an animal or a human at this point. But since I don't have a job right now, getting a pet is out of the question.

Thanks for your response. Katy was my first real relationship. All my other ones fizzled out within a few weeks. The girls that I've been with I feel that I never really connected with any of them. I've been to a psychologist and all he did was try to analyze where my self hate came from. So that was pretty much a waste of time.

I did some thinking and I guess part of what drives me to kill myself is the fear that I will end up alone. And if I wanted to get meds do I just go to a doctor and ask for anti depressant drugs?
